subject: Bulk export for wellness program reporting
verbatim: We need a CSV export of aggregated participation for our 4,200 enrolled employees. Premium page advertises data export but there is no button.

subject: Apple Health sync
verbatim: I want my Apple Watch workouts to appear automatically. Re-entering every run is why I quit the last app I tried.

subject: Lost everything I logged before signing up
verbatim: I tracked three days as a guest then created an account and only one entry came across. The rest are gone.

subject: App unusable on the subway
verbatim: No signal means no logging. Nothing queues up, it just errors and I lose what I typed.

subject: Upgrade button does nothing
verbatim: I tapped Upgrade to Premium and got a toast saying it will be available soon. I want to pay you today.

subject: SSO required before rollout
verbatim: Security will not approve a rollout without SAML SSO against our IdP. Email and password accounts are a blocker.

subject: History only shows this week
verbatim: Exercise history stops at seven days. I want to see last month to know if I am improving.

subject: Profile photo upload fails
verbatim: Uploading a photo from my iPhone fails every time with an error. It is a normal photo straight from the camera.

subject: Articles never change
verbatim: The Discover tab has had the same six articles since I installed the app in April.

subject: No reminders
verbatim: I forget to log dinner. Please add a reminder notification, my old app nudged me at 8pm.

subject: Team challenges
verbatim: Our wellness committee wants step or minute challenges between departments. Right now there is nothing social.

subject: Dark mode text unreadable
verbatim: In dark mode the weekly minutes figure is dark purple on near black. I cannot read it outdoors.

subject: GDPR data deletion request path
verbatim: Under our DPA we must be able to action employee deletion requests within 30 days. There is no self-serve delete or export.

subject: Cannot log a custom activity
verbatim: I do rock climbing and the only options are running walking cycling swimming strength yoga. I log it as other and get a wrong burn estimate.

subject: Weight trend chart
verbatim: I update my weight but there is no chart. I want to see the trend line over 90 days.

subject: Screen reader cannot read the dashboard
verbatim: Using VoiceOver the weekly progress ring is announced as a blank group. I cannot tell how much of my goal is left.

subject: Duplicate entries after sync
verbatim: After signing in on my phone and laptop I now have every breakfast twice.

subject: Analytics page missing
verbatim: Premium says advanced analytics and progress insights. I subscribed to a trial and cannot find any analytics screen.

subject: Audit log for wellness admins
verbatim: Our compliance team needs an admin audit trail of participation data access before we expand past the pilot.

subject: History page takes forever
verbatim: Opening exercise history spins for about eight seconds before anything shows.

subject: Streaks
verbatim: I lost my 21 day streak because there is no streak. Please add one, it is the only reason I opened my last app daily.

subject: Native app in the App Store
verbatim: Is there an iOS app? Using it in Safari means I have no widget and no notifications.

subject: Health Connect sync for Android fleet
verbatim: Our Android users expect Health Connect. Google Fit APIs are being retired and we need a plan before our Q4 renewal.

subject: No way to enter my weight in pounds
verbatim: I am in the US. The profile only accepts kilograms and centimetres. I have been typing my weight in pounds this whole time and the numbers are nonsense.

subject: Height in feet and inches
verbatim: Asking me for centimetres means I have to google my own height. Every other app I have used lets me pick feet and inches.

subject: Can the app build me a workout plan?
verbatim: I do not know what I should be doing week to week. I just repeat the same 30 minute run because the app never suggests anything.

subject: Beginner programme for someone coming back from injury
verbatim: I need something that ramps up over six weeks and schedules rest days. Right now I am guessing and I have already overdone it once.

subject: Monthly participation report for programme review
verbatim: Our quarterly review needs a per-month rollup of minutes and sessions. The history screen only shows one week and we cannot change the range.

subject: Weekly summary email or screen
verbatim: I want one screen that says what I did this week versus last week. I am keeping a spreadsheet alongside the app which defeats the point.

subject: Imperial units for US plant employees
verbatim: Two thirds of our enrolled staff are in Ohio and Texas. Metric-only entry is generating support load on our side and depressing enrolment.

subject: Does the app have any AI coaching?
verbatim: Every competitor I looked at will write me a plan and explain my month in plain language. This one just stores numbers.
